composition_variation: Create a quiet ink-and-watercolor illustration of Hiroshi Nohara from Crayon Shin-chan relaxing on a wooden veranda. Show his familiar short dark hair, stubble, elongated face, and easygoing adult expression. Dress him in a blue casual shirt, beige trousers, and comfortable slippers. He sits with both feet grounded, one hand resting on his knee and the other holding a small coffee mug. Include a potted fern, warm cedar boards, distant green garden shapes, and a calm ivory upper wall. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
